notes.title: Release Notes (v1.0)
notes.content:
[h2]Launch day!![/h2]
Wooooh! It took awhile, but the 1.0 release is finally here. After two years in Early Access we finally wrapped it up. You can see the patch notes below, but besides that there were also lots of graphical upgrades and hundreds of bug fixes. Please report any bugs you see with F11 at the main menu.

Thanks to everybody who supported me on the journey, especially my mom. I've added most of the people who helped me play-test into the credits - they were integral to designing the game and I'm very thankful for them.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[olist]
[*]     Introducing the new [b]Dragon Tamer[/b] guild, adding a fresh layer of strategy and power to your arsenal.
[*]     Explore the possibilities with [b]Augments[/b], allowing you to customize your run and enhance your magical abilities.
[*]     Continue your wizardly journey [b]beyond Day 6[/b], facing increasingly formidable enemies with no additional progression.
[*]     Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world with a graphics overhaul that breathes new life into the game.
[*]     Experience re-balanced enemies, especially the final boss, for an even more challenging and rewarding showdown.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/888332f21624fa204115abfa1b46bc1ed75203f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/7f4727a6f92176ff5e2ce45ac02e29f20f52f36e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/4aea4c58c08b5eedd2320417a440f268e406e611.png[/img]


Thanks for reading, hope you enjoy the game!

[b]- Keith[/b]
Founder of City Wizard Games
[url=https://twitter.com/CityWizardGames]Twitter[/url]
wizardpunkgame@gmail.com


----------------------------------


We're also working on our next game, if you're interested please wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2014160/Dock_King

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 0.70 - "Lich Update"
notes.content:
[b]Winning the Tournament[/b]
[list]
[*] New enemy! Meet the lich on day 6.
[*] Lich comes with unique primary/secondary/homing/ultimate/utility.
[*] Can now beat the game! Day 6 is the final day. Rewards for doing so coming next patch.

notes.title: News on Next Update
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a couple months since any updates. To be honest, I took most of that time off. I started a new job and was traveling quite a bit, so couldn't find the time for my dear baby WizardPunk. But I'm back at it now, and feeling quite refreshed. Here's what to expect in the next update (probably towards the end of January):

- Will finally be able to [b]win the tournament[/b]! There will be a [b]final boss[/b], and probably some adventure mode updates to make the experience more re-playable (I'm thinking the final boss will be on day 6 so it should take about 1-2 hrs for each run).
- Lots more information on spell upgrades (the exact details shown for what is upgraded)
- Lots of [b]nerfs/buffs to particular spells[/b] to make everything more balanced. In particular, Aqua's secondary will now be a knock-up, Arc's secondary will be getting nerfed, and there will probably be changes in store for Vito who I think has the weakest kit right now).
- [b]Improved visuals[/b]. I recently learned a photoshop trick that I can apply on most of the textures in the game to "normalize" their look, which is part of a plan to make the game much more consistent looking.

And that's about all for now. I've also been working on a small game about cognitive behavioral therapy. If that's interesting to you, feel free to reach out, would love to chat about it. Also, I got rid of the game's discord for now. There wasn't much interest/activity in it, so it wasn't worth the effort/time involved sadly. See you in the next update!

Cheers,
Keith

- Lots more information on spell upgrades (the exact details shown for what is upgraded)

notes.title: 'Witch Guild' Update and Halloween Sale
notes.content:
Welcome to Halloweentown! I never saw the movie so I can't make any references .. I'm not sure where I'm going with this. Let's change the topic. NEW GUILD! Let's look at all of the new things in this update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/7c5f3774c1d988c745805a9a7b6451bd2646c468.png[/img]

[b]Witch Guild![/b]
[list]
[*] New guild to join with 3 unique relics and a broom to fly around on
[*] Enemies can now be a witch in the tournament
[*] New achievement for joining
[/list]
[b]Adventure Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Mana is now gained each match (don't have to wait until end of day)
[*] Guilds can be visited at any time of day
[*] Playable characters now reward two mana for defeating them (day 3 and onwards)
[/list]
[b]Main Menu[/b]
[list]
[*] New "Past Runs" menu to see all of the times you .. well, failed.
[/list]
[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed quests that were too basic to simple indicators
[*] Now showing actual quest progress (eg. "1 out of 3 more enemies to defeat")
[*] Quests now tell you if they were completed at end-of-match screen
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/61007f4f19ce26b7f7aa4739b4f2885b7335f8c3.png[/img]

Starting the quest line for the Witch guild gives you a starter broom that flies around rather slow. Defeat an enemy while riding it to gain entry to the guild. At this point you get a much faster broom. Two of the relics affect your broom riding and the third is a new ability:
[list]
[*] [b]Tiana, Power of the Frog[/b] - Gain a spell which temporarily transforms your opponent into a frog.
[*] [b]Cauldron Shield[/b] - Gives you a shield that blocks all projectiles for two seconds upon mounting your broom.
[*] [b]Necklace of Surprise[/b] - Doubles the damage of your first secondary move after mounting your broom.
[/list]
If you haven't picked up a copy yet, the game will be 15% off between October 28th and November 1st for Steam's Halloween Sale. The update will be coming on October 28th to start off the sale.

As always, feedback is much appreciated! Teamwork makes the dream work!

- Keith

notes.title: Update (June 23rd)
notes.content:
[h3]Working hard to have the game ready for the Early Access release. The plan is to have all four guilds playable and to have most spells upgradeable. Plus a few things to make the fights more exciting like in-match objectives (powerups that spawn) and interactive crowds (cheers for big spells and fans with posters of you if you're doing well in the tourney). 

Here's the latest updates:[/h3]

[h2]New clothing for the guilds[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/8935ffe1a601f1f7fb68d606b93b74a30e2034c8.png[/img]
Vito is wearing the hat for the Alchemist Guild.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/8d5de25d4a8ebb7430a17d6124271cfdc1143c8f.png[/img]
Aqua is wearing the hat for the Witch Guild and a necklace from the Alchemist Guild.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/b43aa46689b04f60a822a6feda24dc360d59bf62.png[/img]
Arc is wearing a backpack from the Alchemist Guild here. (Although I've heard feedback that it looks more like a Merchant's backpack .. unfortunately there is no Merchant Guild for now so it will have to be Alchemist)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/d8365ec2a3e58910345cd5b007f8a99b8ef0a072.png[/img]
Ignissa here is wearing the hat and the shoulders from the Beastmaster Guild.

[h2]Objectives[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/ea768a4fe54ce9c6beadc01e4c07cf0c43eb3e58.png[/img]
Left - attack powerup that temporarily doubles your strength.
Middle - health powerup that refills you 1/5 of your total health (only in Versus mode).
Right - speed powerup that temporarily doubles your speed.
These spawn in specific spots in the arena every 30 seconds or so.

[h2]Polish[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/75b27b59db0436fe64aa007fbd22f3875616374d.png[/img]
New intro effects for the characters, this is for the fire wizards like Ignissa.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/d4c1ae10abd2708dd76f7b86f5a403511bd8832b.png[/img]
Upgraded arcane primary move. Lots of other upgrades to come.

[h2]Sponsored Custom Robo tournament[/h2]
[h3]If you see this before June 26th, I'm sponsoring a tournament with a cool CR community here: https://t.co/SebmzXqYWD?amp=1[/h3]

[h2]Lofi video featuring the game[/h2]
[previewyoutube=7bcEYKJ8iWk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Did a cool side project involving the game - made one of those lofi "chill vibes to study to" mixes with a one-minute loop from the game's main menu.

Thanks for reading and stay tuned!
- Keith

notes.title: Alpha build release (Oct 2020) for Discord members
notes.content:
Hello, hello! What a glorious time of year, still in a pandemic and approaching an insane election time in the US! Let us escape from that for a second, and let me tell you what is new with Wizardpunk.

If you just want to play it, you can do so by joining the discord here: https://t.co/X09OVqmY2p?amp=1

[h2]Future[/h2]
We've arrived at a point jusssst before adding a ton of content. One of those is a profession system, so you can choose between Shaman, Witch/Warlock, Beastmaster, and Alchemist. You will get quests from your guild leader and can grow stronger that way. Next will be adding some real dialog and story - starting with the announcer that is walking around the overworld right now. He will be your guide for the tournament and will be the knowledge source. Then all of the characters will have some dynamic dialog like congratulating you for a good match or saying sorry if you barely got out, things like that. Last thing lined up for content is crowd interactions, making them hold up signs of their favorite contestant, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/68ab19a926511238bd3fd99f0b7404f2fc342d18.png[/img]

[h1]New stuff[/h1]
[h3]Local multiplayer[/h3]
In versus mode, just change 'AI' to 'Player 2', and choose your input.

[h3] Can play as Skelli, Draggi, and Raijin now[/h3]
Previously, they were only CPU opponents. Go to versus mode and cycle through the characters to find them.

[h3]Homing moves[/h3]
These moves start on the ground next to you (can't use while in-air), and they automatically try to seek out the opponent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/2a846a192b4656216cd647c4e8050829ccdb43cb.png[/img]

[h3]Destructible Terrain[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/c84b835854f056650c3294dd8f1623a65e897da2.png[/img]

[h3]Day and night system[/h3]

[h3]Crowds for matches[/h3]

notes.title: Progress Update (May 2020 - Steam Summer Fest)
notes.content:
[h2]New Enemy - "Raijin"[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/a69e9ea0084b9302482e405075dad72479de9ea0.png[/img]

Raijin is currently the only non-playable real enemy besides Skelli. I've had some negative feedback about fighting the default "city wizards" all the time, so I'm thinking about having a much larger roster of original characters like this than I originally planned. That should help pad out the brackets such that it's not the same character (with a different colored hat) that you are fighting each time. Would be cool to go a "dragonball" route where you have some mediocre but interesting characters that are unique but weaker in general than characters like Raijin.

[h2]Storyboards for Arc & Aqua[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/40e31a56d4dc50ed4b34b43e00063c1f22a06698.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/81aee0d3d815b5808f017c38faf8512f7d514a8a.png[/img]

Last time I only had Vito's and Ignissa's done. These are really the only story in the game so far, which I'm not really excited about. Will be adding dialog with other characters soon and working to expand upon these "origin stories" with each character. Hoping to implement a way to take a character in one of two directions. As an example, I'd like to explore a Vito that says "f*ck my temple, I'm going rogue" and then another Vito that stays true to them at all costs. Kind of like in Fable where you can choose evil or good.

[h2]New shield move for Vito[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/2b60ee94ebd319d5ed6242ec87cb4424c4149f4f.png[/img]

[h2]New blink move for Arc[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/ea9728ccc763cd63076af6d295227def143932a6.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Summer Festival[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/144e08f4881482716c65c9368a563d779cabc0ac.png[/img]

This is hopefully going to be really good for the game, as it should put it in front of a bunch of new people, and most importantly get some feedback on if it's fun in it's current state. I wasn't planning to release a demo for a little while longer, so the demo that people will play is not ideal, but I didn't want to pass up so many potential new players. You can't have the demo up before or immediately after, so the demo will be playable from June 9th till June 14th if you want to try it out.

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/0a6d8cb452b5764af3083dec140b01794e89620a.png[/img]

I've got this in-game for players to see when they win or lose in adventure mode, and I'm hoping I get some feedback on which ones sound interesting. If you're reading this and have an opinion on the matter, please message me on Twitter! (@keiththomasdev) This will help decide the direction I take from here on out.

Besides this list, I have three main areas of focus:
[olist]
[*] Further improving the combat with things like:
   a. "Heat-seeking" shots that will eliminate degenerate gameplay like sitting behind a wall.
   b. Environmental hazards (accomplishing the same thing)
[*] More stuff to do while in town, to take a break from fighting. Maybe some minigames, or maybe 
    just a bunch of people to talk to, probably a bit of both.
[*] More of a focus on the "tournament" part, so having an announcer and a crowd and events in 
    town when ending a bracket.
[/olist]

Thanks for reading.
- Keith

notes.title: Progress update!! (February 2020)
notes.content:
[h1]Updates[/h1]
[b]L[/b]ots and lots of improvements since the beginning of the year! (When the steam page was first setup)

[b]New overall look (darker theme) and some new UI (courtesy of my friend Erik):[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/9142dd8a4902df4d87af0ba3bdea55942a96953d.png[/img]

Started working with an artist ([url=https://twitter.com/Little_BigBoots]@Little_BigBoots[/url]) who has produced a couple amazing buildings for the game, a mini-mart and a hotel.

[b]Mini-mart store where you buy your character upgrades:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/cf004744ddf91488cc59c75f355cf03d3ebe2bc0.png[/img]

[b]Hotel where you can rest and access the menu:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/d4ba1588a14800a3e81a0771d18529a2e9d6b5ae.png[/img]

[b]New main menu screen:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/35929d21856105c8815c4f277db3093ab12ae721.png[/img]

[h1]Work-in-Progress[/h1]

[b]W[/b]orking on a "tournament bracket" system instead of the old adventure progression. The plan is to allow selection of a path and reward players for fighting harder wizards in the first round. It's easier to wait to fight them until the final round because you'll have earned a bit more mana (the currency) and can buy a couple more upgrades.

[b]New WIP[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/5ede8f35ccb80b151812011848461fc7c4487181.png[/img]
[b]Old style[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/13f2ea21577322a0a09ba7c25673e3b8689ce7b8.png[/img]

[b]W[/b]orking with an artist ([url=www.instagram.com/identikit_bode]@identikit_bode[/url]) who is creating some super stylish comic panels for each character. I'm planning to tell the whole story this way. Start/end and maybe some interspersed through the middle. Only have Vito's and Ignissa's right now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36495861/5c734815c7df9367e4ad6e35f8efe222e170c2a1.png[/img]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

[i][b]Yo, I thought you were releasing a demo?[/b][/i]
Yeah .. still working on it. I've done a ton of graphical upgrades but not a ton of gameplay upgrades, so it isn't much further along than the last itch.io [url=https://kryzodoze.itch.io/wizardpunk]demo[/url] from November. At least gameplay-wise. The bracket work is towards that goal though, so hoping to have a solid demo in a couple months. Plan for the demo is: you fight a couple "bosses" in the adventure mode and can buy some meaningful upgrades for your wizard and your spells.

[i][b]What are you working on?[/b][/i]
Sooo, I've got the following things on my to-do list:
[list]
[*] Finish bracket system
[*] One more building - a "spell mechanic" who upgrades your spells
[*] Finish controller support (only half works right now)
[*] SFX for random things I forgot like walking and rolling and UI clicks
[*] Some way to see all your upgrades and health and stuff in the overworld, some sort of "character" screen
[*] Local multiplayer - this is a big one and should be a stepping stone towards online multiplayer which is not a for sure thing, but I want to investigate it
[/list]

Thanks for reading! I post more on [url=https://twitter.com/WizardpunkGame]my twitter[/url] if you want to follow there, but I'll drop the larger posts here.

- Keith
